job_roles.role_title: DevOps Engineer (5-6 Years Experience) – Cloud Infrastructure & Automation Specialist

career_sections.title: Your Opportunity
career_sections.heading: Role Overview
career_sections.description: Join us as a DevOps Engineer where you will play a critical role in building, scaling, and maintaining robust infrastructure systems. This role sits at the intersection of development and operations, enabling faster releases, reliable systems, and seamless user experiences. You will work on modern cloud platforms, implement automation, and ensure high availability and performance across our systems. In our fast-paced startup environment, your work directly impacts system reliability, scalability, and engineering velocity.

key_features.title: What You'll Do
key_features.description:
• Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for rapid and reliable deployments
• Automate infrastructure provisioning using IaC tools
• Monitor system performance, uptime, and reliability
• Troubleshoot production issues and optimize system performance
• Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment processes

key_features.title: Why This Role Is Exciting
key_features.description:
• Work on cutting-edge cloud and DevOps technologies
• High ownership of infrastructure and system reliability
• Direct impact on product scalability and performance
• Opportunity to design systems from ground up
• Fast-paced environment with real-time problem solving
• Path to evolve into DevOps Lead, Cloud Architect, or SRE

career_sections.title: Who Can Apply
career_sections.heading: Required Skills
career_sections.description: We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, and automation.

key_features.title: Core Skills
key_features.description:
• Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
• Proficiency in CI/CD tools and pipelines
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
• Strong understanding of Linux systems and networking
• Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
• Problem-solving mindset with debugging and troubleshooting skills
• Strong understanding of system design, scalability, and reliability

key_features.title: Tool Knowledge
key_features.description:
• CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
• Container tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)
• Version control systems (Git)
• Scripting languages (Bash, Python)
• Bonus: Experience with security best practices and DevSecOps

career_sections.title: Your Responsibilities
career_sections.heading: What You’ll Work On
career_sections.description: Your work will focus on infrastructure automation, deployment pipelines, system monitoring, and improving engineering productivity.

key_features.title: Infrastructure & Cloud Management
key_features.description:
• Design and manage cloud infrastructure for scalability and reliability
• Optimize infrastructure costs and performance
• Implement high availability and disaster recovery strategies
• Manage networking, load balancing, and storage systems
• Ensure infrastructure security and compliance

key_features.title: CI/CD & Automation
key_features.description:
• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for multiple environments
• Automate build, test, and deployment workflows
• Reduce manual intervention through automation
• Ensure fast and reliable release cycles
• Implement rollback and fail-safe deployment strategies

key_features.title: Monitoring & Reliability
key_features.description:
• Set up monitoring, alerting, and logging systems
• Track system metrics, uptime, and performance
• Identify and resolve bottlenecks proactively
• Ensure system reliability and availability (SLA/SLO)
• Perform root cause analysis for incidents

key_features.title: Security & Compliance
key_features.description:
• Implement security best practices across infrastructure
• Manage access control and secrets management
• Ensure compliance with industry standards
• Conduct vulnerability assessments and fixes
• Work towards DevSecOps practices

key_features.title: Collaboration & Enablement
key_features.description:
• Work closely with developers to streamline deployments
• Support teams in debugging production issues
• Improve developer experience and productivity
• Document processes, architectures, and best practices
• Contribute to engineering culture and standards

career_sections.title: What You Will Learn
career_sections.heading: Your Learning Journey
career_sections.description: This role offers deep exposure to modern DevOps practices, scalable architecture, and cloud-native technologies.

key_features.title: Cloud & Infrastructure Mastery
key_features.description:
• Advanced cloud architecture and design patterns
• Infrastructure as Code best practices
• High availability and distributed systems
• Cost optimization strategies in cloud environments
• Multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure setups

key_features.title: Automation & DevOps Excellence
key_features.description:
• Advanced CI/CD pipeline design
• Automation frameworks and tools
• Container orchestration and scaling strategies
• Release engineering and deployment strategies
• Infrastructure monitoring and alerting systems

key_features.title: Security & Reliability Engineering
key_features.description:
• DevSecOps practices and secure deployments
• Reliability engineering (SRE principles)
• Incident management and root cause analysis
• System resilience and fault tolerance
• Observability and logging strategies

key_features.title: Startup Engineering Experience
key_features.description:
• Building systems that scale from 0 → 1 → 100
• Handling real-world production challenges
• Making infrastructure decisions under ambiguity
• Collaborating across fast-moving teams
• Direct impact on product performance and growth
